concept.title: Transport to a service for someone who cannot use a bus
concept.shortdesc: As a carer of someone who cannot manage a bus, I need transport to get him to and from a service safely, so that he can attend.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-012). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: carers, older people, people with limited mobility.
Situation: A service is only usable if he can get there.
A good result: Community transport or volunteer drivers that cover the route, with eligibility and how to book.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: What about transport? Gerald can't manage a bus.
